title: Codex sessions with approval policy "never" cannot call TermAl's or Engram's read-only MCP tools ("requires approval, but approval policy is never")
outcome: A Codex session started with a read-only sandbox and approval policy "never" can still call read-only MCP tools (Engram reads, TermAl mailbox read, send and acknowledge) without an approval prompt, so a locked-down observer session needs no CLI workaround.
acceptance: In a Codex session with sandbox read-only and approval policy never, TermAl's read-only and mailbox MCP tools and Engram's read words succeed without an approval request, while any writing tool or sandbox-escaping command is still refused; a test covers the generated configuration for both cases.
